describe: The image shows a wooden wall panel made of about three large horizontal planks of weathered brown wood with long grain streaks and pale highlights. Two thick vertical posts cross the planks, one near the centre-left and one near the centre-right. Transparent grey edges surround the planks. Colours are muted brown, tan and grey, with low to moderate contrast. This is a texture sheet of a few large pieces: every plank and post must stay exactly in place.
